findings.issue: Single pending queue could discard a different PR publication.
findings.disposition: Fixed with queue:max (up to100 pending); both configured models rechecked affected publication coverage.

findings.issue: Older PR heads lacked a newly required composer test file.
findings.disposition: Fixed by running composer tests from trusted workflow source; actual candidate build passed on pre-change source.

findings.issue: Retargeted PR previews used eligibility inconsistent with the main-base resolver.
findings.disposition: Fixed main-base eligibility and retarget regression. Sol initially assessed impact as nonblocking; retained for consistency.

findings.issue: Manual feature-branch bootstrap was alleged to execute untrusted code with publishing authority.
findings.disposition: Refuted under explicitly approved reviewed-branch bootstrap and exact-branch environment; original concern applies if that branch is treated as untrusted. Parent reviews exact head before manual dispatch; automatic PR builds remain isolated.
